chants.notes: Tempore paschali block prints 'AL. et OF. ut supra.' — the paschal Alleluia is this same chant (p429), so no separate row.

The two share chant_group 786, which the loader's slot+chant_group dedup could not hold before option_num entered the key (2026-09-06); recovered 2026-09-16.
